source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Battle with the secret super-boss, an ouroboros dragon of endless stories: a long epic multi-section battle — prelude, relentless main section, a quiet eerie middle, a massive climax. Tempo 168 BPM, 4/4 time, key of E♭ minor. Instrumentation: organ, wordless choir (no words), brass, fast strings, heavy drums, gong, electric bass. Form: prelude, main battle section, quiet middle, climax, back to the main section. Duration: 120 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
